name: Veszprémvarsány (Hungary)
description: Green field with a yellow cross set towards the fly, charged in the upper hoist with the municipal arms of Veszprémvarsány: a quartered green and white shield with a sun, a lion, a cross and a bough.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
